app.title: settling-map
app.tagline: French property prices, and how reliable they are

legend.title: Median price, €/m²
legend.priceOnlyNote: Textures describe the reliability of the price.

inspector.title: Place details
inspector.empty: Select a commune to see its median price and how solid the figure is.

confidence.0: No sales kept in the period. A lack of data does not mean a low price.
confidence.1: Few sales: treat this figure with caution.
confidence.2: A moderate number of sales: a fairly solid figure.
confidence.3: A high number of sales: a solid figure.
confidence.4: Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte: these sales are not in the DVF database. A lack of data does not mean a low price.

inspector.disclaimer: Indicative: median sale price divided by built surface. It is not a valuation of any property.
inspector.windowWide: Period widened to {{months}} months because of few sales
inspector.noIndicators: No other indicators at this level.

sources.title: Sources and limits
sources.method: Price per m² is the median of house and flat sales (one dwelling per sale, off-plan sales excluded) divided by built surface. Land sold with a house is included in its price. Sales are aggregated by commune: no individual sale is shown.
sources.limits: Départements 57, 67, 68 and Mayotte are not covered by the DVF database. The data lags by about one semester.

sources.privacy: No account, no cookies. Only anonymous usage totals are counted (see below). Map tiles are loaded from OpenFreeMap and Cloudflare.
sources.methodExtra: The other indicators (risks, altitude, climate, distances, fibre, rent, land tax, recorded crime on request) are values per commune from public data; an unknown stays empty, never 0. Risks do not describe your plot and do not replace the official risk statement (ERRIAL). Climate is interpolated from nearby stations. Distances run in a straight line from a point in the commune to the nearest facility in INSEE's permanent facilities base: they are not travel times. Rent is an asking rent, and the land-tax rate is not the tax bill.

privacy.title: Anonymous usage counts
privacy.explain: settling-map counts, without identifying you, how often pages and features are used: totals per day, with no IP address, no cookie and no typed text. The Do Not Track signal is respected.

risk.title: Risks
risk.note: Commune-level screening indicators: they do not describe your plot and do not replace the official risk statement (ERRIAL).

relief.title: Altitude and relief
relief.note: Altitude at the town-hall point (chef-lieu); height range between the lowest and highest points of the commune.

climate.title: Climate
climate.note: Values interpolated from Météo-France stations, not measured in the commune.

services.title: Nearby (straight line)
services.note: Straight-line distances from one point of the commune, not travel times.

connectivity.title: Internet
connectivity.note: Fibre eligibility, not a subscription or a guaranteed speed.

costs.title: Housing costs
costs.note: Advertised rent and voted tax rate: benchmarks, not the cost of a given home.

safety.title: Recorded crime
safety.note: Recorded offences, not the risk of being a victim: figures also depend on how many people report, and swing widely from year to year in small communes.

price.name: Median price per m²
price.about: Median sale price per square metre of built floor area (DVF).

seismic.name: Seismic zone
seismic.about: Regulatory seismic zone of the commune, from 1 (very low) to 5 (high). It sets building rules; it is not a survey of your land.

flood.name: Flooding
flood.about: How far the State's flood procedures have gone in the commune (Géorisques): a flood-zone atlas or the departmental risk file (DDRM), then a prevention plan prescribed, then approved. It is not a measure of your plot's exposure and does not replace the official risk statement (ERRIAL). 0 means no procedure recorded, not no risk.

clay.name: Clay shrink-swell

classes.0: soil not expected to be clay

clay.about: Regional exposure map by BRGM: it shows where a soil study is worth doing before building, not the state of your land.

radon.name: Radon
radon.about: Soil radon potential per commune (ASNR, formerly IRSN). Only a measurement inside the home gives the real exposure.

cavities.name: Underground cavities
cavities.about: Number of cavities in the BRGM inventory (quarries, cellars, works, natural cavities). 0 means none known, not none.

altitude.name: Altitude
altitude.about: Altitude of the town-hall point (chef-lieu, IGN), not of the whole commune: large mountain communes vary a lot from place to place.

relief.name: Relief
relief.about: Difference between the lowest and highest point of the commune: a sense of the terrain, not the slope of your land.

sunshine.name: Sunshine
sunshine.about: Average sunshine 1991-2020, interpolated from nearby Météo-France stations: a regional trend, not the shade in your street.

heat.name: Hot days
heat.legend: Days at 30 °C or more per year
heat.filter: Days at 30 °C or more, at most
heat.about: Average number of days per year, 1991-2020, with a maximum of 30 °C or more, interpolated from nearby stations.

heat2050.name: Hot days around 2050
heat2050.about: Observed 1991-2020 normal plus the modelled increase for a France warmed by 2.7 °C (TRACC reference pathway, around 2050). A projection, not a forecast.

fibre.name: Fibre broadband
fibre.about: Share of homes and business premises eligible for fibre to the premises (Arcep). Eligible means neither subscribed nor a guaranteed speed.

rent.name: Indicative rent
rent.about: Indicative advertised rent including charges, combining flats and houses (carte des loyers). An average of listings, not the rent of a given home.

landtax.name: Property tax
landtax.about: Rate voted by the commune and its intercommunality on built property. The amount due also depends on the rental value of the home.

violence.name: Offences against persons
violence.legend: Recorded offences against persons, per 1,000 residents per year
violence.about: Violence against persons recorded by police and gendarmerie (SSMSI), where the offence took place, per 1,000 residents.

burglary.name: Home burglaries
burglary.legend: Recorded home burglaries, per 1,000 dwellings per year
burglary.about: Home burglaries recorded by police and gendarmerie (SSMSI), per 1,000 dwellings (not per 1,000 residents).
